about: Behaviour checks for urgent calls (docs/assistant/urgent-call.md; the instructions' 加急来电 section and the urgent_call tool): what just happened, what the owner said in the conversation, and whether the assistant rings the owner's phone. Synthetic cases only. want: call or no_call; why and rule: what a call must give. rules: the owner's own rules besides the built-in ones (drop_rules removes built-in ones for one case). known: why the model gets the case wrong today; the live check reports it and does not fail on it.
system: 你是 Persona 助手。用户打开了加急来电，下面是你的说明里关于它的部分、urgent_call 工具的说明、刚发生的事，以及用户最近在这个对话里说过的话。判断现在要不要用 urgent_call 给用户打电话。只回一个 JSON 对象：{"call": true 或 false, "why": "owner_asked" 或 "rule" 或 "", "rule": 规则 id 或 "", "owner_quote": 用户原话或 "", "happening": 一句话事实或 "", "reason": 一句话理由}。
